name.fr: Politique de mot de passe et verrouillage

title.en: Auth status exposes password policy (min length 16+)

description.en: GET /api/v1/auth/status includes password_policy.min_length ≥ 12 (default 16) used by registration and change-password UI.
description.uk: GET /api/v1/auth/status містить password_policy.min_length ≥ 12 (типово 16) для UI реєстрації та зміни пароля.

description.es: GET /api/v1/auth/status includes password_policy.min_length ≥ 12 (default 16) used by registration and change-password UI.
description.de: GET /api/v1/auth/status includes password_policy.min_length ≥ 12 (default 16) used by registration and change-password UI.

precondition.en: API is healthy; no auth required for /auth/status.
precondition.fr: API is healthy; no auth required for /auth/status.
precondition.es: API is healthy; no auth required for /auth/status.
precondition.de: API is healthy; no auth required for /auth/status.

expected_result.en: password_policy.min_length ≥ 12; require_letter and require_digit flags present; login form password input has no minlength (legacy short passwords may still sign in).

expected_result.de: password_policy.min_length ≥ 12; require_letter and require_digit flags present; login form password input has no minlength (legacy short passwords may still sign in).
